# 词典 Y

## 概述

本页收录以字母 Y 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设 yield 多义用法详解与 YAML vs. JSON 对比，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇           | 词性      | 含义             | 常见搭配                                         | 例句                                                |
| -------------- | --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| yield          | v./n.     | 产出，收益；让步 | yield results, high yield                        | The new strategy yielded impressive results.        |
| year-over-year | adj./adv. | 同比的           | year-over-year growth, year-over-year comparison | Revenue grew 15% year-over-year.                    |
| yardstick      | n.        | 衡量标准         | use as a yardstick, performance yardstick        | Customer satisfaction is our primary yardstick.     |
| yeoman         | adj.      | 忠实勤恳的       | yeoman work, yeoman service                      | The intern did yeoman work on the data migration.   |
| year-end       | n./adj.   | 年终的           | year-end report, year-end bonus                  | The year-end review is scheduled for December.      |
| year-round     | adj./adv. | 全年的           | year-round service, open year-round              | The resort offers year-round activities for guests. |
| yield curve    | n.        | 收益率曲线       | inverted yield curve, yield curve analysis       | An inverted yield curve often signals a recession.  |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇      | 词性      | 含义                 | 常见搭配                             | 例句                                                          |
| --------- | --------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| yearn     | v.        | 渴望，向往           | yearn for, yearn to travel           | She yearns for a peaceful life in the countryside.            |
| youthful  | adj.      | 年轻的，充满活力的   | youthful energy, youthful appearance | He maintains a youthful spirit despite his age.               |
| yield     | v.        | 让路，屈服           | yield to pressure, yield to traffic  | You must yield to pedestrians at the crosswalk.               |
| yawn      | v./n.     | 打呵欠；令人无聊的事 | stifle a yawn, yawn with boredom     | He couldn't help but yawn during the long speech.             |
| yearly    | adj./adv. | 每年的；每年地       | yearly review, yearly subscription   | We hold a yearly gathering for all alumni.                    |
| youngster | n.        | 年轻人，小孩         | talented youngster                   | The youngsters in the neighborhood organized a charity event. |
| yell      | v./n.     | 大喊，叫喊           | yell at someone, let out a yell      | Please don't yell; let's talk calmly.                         |
| yonder    | adv./adj. | 那边的               | over yonder, way yonder              | The old farmhouse is just over yonder.                        |
| yarn      | n.        | 纱线；冗长的故事     | spin a yarn, ball of yarn            | Grandpa loves to spin a yarn about his childhood.             |

## 技术相关

| 词汇         | 词性   | 含义                     | 常见搭配                      | 例句                                                             |
| ------------ | ------ | ------------------------ | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| YAML         | n.     | YAML 数据序列化格式      | YAML file, YAML configuration | The deployment settings are stored in a YAML file.               |
| yarn         | n.     | Yarn 包管理器            | yarn install, yarn add        | Run yarn install to set up the project dependencies.             |
| Y-combinator | n.     | Y 组合子（函数式编程）   | Y-combinator pattern          | The Y-combinator enables anonymous recursion in lambda calculus. |
| yotta        | prefix | 尧（10²⁴，计量单位前缀） | yottabyte                     | A yottabyte equals one trillion terabytes.                       |
| yum          | n.     | Linux 包管理器           | yum install, yum update       | Use yum install to add packages on CentOS systems.               |

## yield 多义用法详解

Y 开头的实用词汇不多，但在商务和财务语境中，yield 是高频核心词：

| 用法            | 含义         | 例句                                                           |
| --------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| yield + results | 产出结果     | The experiment yielded unexpected results.                     |
| yield + profit  | 产生利润     | The investment yielded a 12% annual return.                    |
| yield to + noun | 让步于       | The company yielded to public pressure and changed its policy. |
| yield (交通)    | 让行         | Yield to oncoming traffic before turning left.                 |
| yield (编程)    | 生成器产出值 | In Python, yield pauses a generator and returns a value.       |
| dividend yield  | 股息率       | The stock offers a 3% dividend yield.                          |

## YAML vs. JSON 对比

| 比较维度   | YAML                    | JSON             |
| ---------- | ----------------------- | ---------------- |
| 可读性     | 更好，使用缩进          | 较好，使用花括号 |
| 注释支持   | 支持 # 注释             | 不支持注释       |
| 数据类型   | 自动推断类型            | 显式字符串需引号 |
| 常见用途   | 配置文件（Docker、K8s） | API 数据交换     |
| 文件扩展名 | .yml 或 .yaml           | .json            |
